description:
Create a replacement for your key, keeping the old key ACTIVE. Requires OAuth security:write.

    Returns the replacement secret ONCE with its new ID. Install it in the
    consumer, test it, then call revoke_account_api_key with previous_key_id.
    Do not revoke until the replacement is working. Each call creates a key;
    do not retry blindly after a lost response. Never publish the secret.
name: rotate_account_api_key
